name: week
title: Trade promotions this week
subtitle: What is in store, what retailers have claimed, and what the checks found

sections.title: Needs a person
sections.note: Promotions close to store and not agreed, claims to match and approve, and every check that failed.
sections.sql: select what,item,detail from (select 1 as ord,'live or starting soon, not agreed' as what,ref as item,customer||', in store '||instore_start as detail from promo_totals where status in ('draft','proposed') and instore_start<=current_date+(select value from policy where key='notice_days')::int union all select 2,'claim to match',ref,customer||' '||retailer_ref from claim_work where status='open' and promotion is null union all select 3,'claim to approve',ref,customer||' '||retailer_ref||' on '||promotion from claim_work where status='matched' union all select 4,'check '||rule,ref,subject||': '||finding from compliance_findings) a order by ord,item

sections.title: In store in the next six weeks
sections.sql: select instore_start,instore_end,ref,customer,title,mechanic,phase,forecast_units,actual_units,currency,trade_spend_cents,notice_on from promo_totals where phase in ('proposed','upcoming','live','draft') and instore_start<=current_date+42 order by instore_start

sections.title: Claims and deductions to clear
sections.note: Oldest first. A set-off is a deduction taken off a remittance.
sections.sql: select ref,customer,retailer_ref,received_on,days_open,kind,method,currency,amount_cents,promotion,expected_cents,status from claim_work where status in ('open','matched','disputed') order by days_open desc

name: money
title: Trade spend
subtitle: Accruals, budgets and what each promotion returned

sections.title: Open accruals
sections.note: Scan and fixed funding owed on promotions that have started, less claims already matched. Off-invoice is not accrued: it came off the invoice.
sections.sql: select customer,ref,phase,instore_start,instore_end,currency,accrued_cents,claimed_cents,open_cents,basis from accruals order by customer,instore_start

sections.title: Budget by customer
sections.sql: select customer,year_start,currency,budget_cents,committed_cents,proposed_cents,spent_cents,remaining_cents from budget_work order by year_start desc,customer

sections.title: Post-event results
sections.note: Extra gross profit is promotion gross profit less what the baseline would have earned at list price. ROI is that divided by trade spend.
sections.sql: select ref,customer,title,mechanic,instore_start,baseline_units,units,uplift_pct,currency,trade_spend_cents,incremental_gp_cents,roi from evaluation order by instore_start desc

name: grocery-code
title: Grocery code checks
subtitle: Promotion funding, notice, order cuts, set-offs and price increases against the NZ and AU codes

sections.title: What the checks found
sections.note: Rules and sources are in docs/compliance.md. This is a record check, not legal advice.
sections.sql: select rule,ref,subject,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,ref

sections.title: Supply agreements
sections.sql: select code,name,country,large_grocery,funding_clause,setoff_clause,payment_days from customers where active order by country,code

sections.title: Price increases
sections.sql: select c.name as customer,c.country,i.notified_on,i.effective_on,i.pct,i.response,i.responded_on from price_increases i join customers c on c.id=i.customer_id order by i.notified_on desc
